The case describes a 2-year-old female with chronic (weeks-duration), non-acute irritability, in the absence of overt systemic or neurological signs *by history alone*. Critically, no objective physical or neurological examination has been performed; no diagnostic data (labs, imaging, EEG, audiology, developmental testing) are available. Irritability, unspecified
